<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/process/{pid}/signal"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sends TERM, KILL, HUP, INT, USR1 or USR2 to one process with kill, and reports changed: true. A process that the host does not have is not found. A process ID below 1 is refused, because kill sends to a group of processes for 0 and for a negative ID. One above 4194304, Linux's largest pid_max, is refused too.
